summary: A neighbor says they would do favors for others more readily than they expect favors back.
realLife: Pew's 2025 survey found people say they would bring in mail or bring a meal for a neighbor more often than they believe neighbors would do the same for them.
sources: Pew Research Center, how connected Americans feel to neighbors (March 2025 survey): https://www.pewresearch.org/short-reads/2025/05/08/how-connected-do-americans-feel-to-their-neighbors/
inGame: neighbor ties and traits; the gap between giving and expecting can be carried by a generosity trait and a trust level on the tie

turns.summary: The neighbor asks for a small favor outright.
The neighbor would help anyone but never asks for help themself.
turns.writesBack: tie stays one-way; a quiet resentment may build

turns.summary: The neighbor remembers exactly who owes whom.
